description:
Lion is getting ready for bed when he hears a strange noise. What could it be? Is it a monster? The BIGGEST, SCARIEST monster EVER?

A short story in the present tense by TheFableCottage.com, designed for language learners but enjoyable for everyone. 

More stories like this in English, French, Italian, Spanish and German at https://www.thefablecottage.com
